name: Cross
overview: The biblical teaching on the cross emphasizes both the literal and figurative aspects of bearing it as a symbol of discipleship and sacrifice. Jesus calls His followers to deny themselves, take up their cross, and follow Him, highlighting the personal cost and commitment involved (Matthew 10:38; 16:24; Mark 8:34; 10:21). The cross was also physically borne by Simon of Cyrene, compelled to carry Jesus' cross on the way to crucifixion, underscoring the reality of suffering associated with it (Matthew 27:32; Mark 15:21). Together, these verses portray the cross as central to the Christian life, both as the instrument of Jesus' crucifixion and as a metaphor for the believer's call to self-denial and faithful discipleship.
